answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 62696 Country: United States of America Title: Reading Sana after getting up Question: If you miss any of the rakahs of fardh salah being offered in jamah, are you supposed to read Sana after getting up after Imam's salaam? Answer ID: 62696 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 152/152/B=03/1437) Yes, Sana should be recited. It is mustahab and desirable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
